messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: automated page fired for HTTP 5xx rate spike (error-rate > 8% over 5m) in eu-west-1. Affected service: inference-api-prod. Links: https://console.redwood.ai/alerts/1769012345 , Pager: pagerduty#PD-3821

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty incident PD-3821 created and routed to: Ops-Oncall. Escalation policy: default-sre.

Ops-Oncall: ack'd. I'm taking primary. Starting triage — checking load and recent deploys.

Alex: seeing a big spike in 5xxs on the edge LB, error pattern is "502 Bad Gateway" and some 503s. Not all regions, mostly eu-west-1, small bump in eu-central.

Maya: checking ingress controller logs now. Quick grep:
```
kubectl -n ingress logs ingress-controller-7f8 -c nginx | grep -E "502|503" | tail -n 50
2026-03-14T08:12:01Z 10.1.2.5 "GET /v1/generate" 502 0 0 "-" "curl/7.68.0" 0.123
2026-03-14T08:12:02Z 10.1.2.5 "POST /v1/chat" 503 0 0 "-" "python-requests/2.28" 0.456
```
Maya: looks like upstream (inference pods) returning errors or dropping connections.

Devon: any recent model-serving deploys or infra changes in eu-west-1 in the last 30m?

Ops-Oncall: There was a scaled rollout for inference-svc:v2.14.3 ten minutes ago (canary->50%). I'm going to check pod health and replica distribution.

Alex: also seeing elevated latency on the model runtime containers before the 5xxs. Might be OOM kills or heavy GC. Pulling container logs.

Ops-Oncall: pod list -n prod:
```
NAME                                  READY   STATUS    RESTARTS   AGE
inference-svc-7f9c8d4-abcde           0/1     CrashLoop 3          4m
inference-svc-7f9c8d4-fghij           1/1     Running   0          4m
inference-svc-7f9c8d4-klmno           1/1     Running   0          4m
```
Ops-Oncall: one of the canary pods is CrashLooping. Logs show repeated OOMKilled in container runtime.

Devon: rollback canary to previous stable immediately. Command:
```
kubectl -n prod rollout undo deployment/inference-svc --to-revision=22
```
Devon: also bump replicas temporarily for serving to absorb load:
```
kubectl -n prod scale deployment inference-svc --replicas=6
```

Ops-Oncall: running rollback now and scaling replicas. Will update in 30s.

pagerduty-bot: Ops-Oncall acknowledged PD-3821 at 1769012350. Time to ack: 5s.

(30s later)

Ops-Oncall: rollback triggered, scale to 6 applied. Monitoring error-rate. Prometheus query: `sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="inference-api",status=~"5.."}[1m])) / sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="inference-api"}[1m])) * 100`

Alex: after rollback, 5xx rate dropped from ~9.2% -> 1.1% within 40s for eu-west-1. Still seeing a few noisy hosts but trending down.

Maya: ingress LB connection drain showing decrease in 502s. No active customer-facing pages open in support.

Elena: patch for customer comms: "We've detected a transient increase in request errors to the Redwood inference API in eu-west-1 between 08:11–08:14 UTC. The team rolled back a recent canary and scaled capacity; the service is stable now. Investigating root cause; we'll follow up with a postmortem." Want me to send to CSMs?

Alex: yes please — send to CSMs and flag customers with heavy usage in eu-west-1. No PII in the note.

Devon: creating an incident postmortem stub and assigning eng-runtime for root cause analysis (possible memory regression in v2.14.3). Ticket: INT-1158.

Ops-Oncall: PD incident closed (auto) after acknowledgement and mitigation steps. Confirming last 5xx spike at 1769012405.

incident-bot: Incident resolved: 5xx spike mitigated via rollback + scale. Follow-up: ENG-RUNTIME to investigate memory regression; ENG-SRE to add runbook step for rapid rollback and autoscaler safeguards.

Maya: adding logs and heap profiles to INT-1158.

Elena: support update sent to CSMs and posted to status page draft.

Alex: will run canary in a staging cluster and add memory limits/requests stricter checks before next canary.

Ops-Oncall: closing thread. Will keep INT-1158 open until RCA & mitigation complete. Thanks all :thumbsup:
